Ahri.watch: Getting hit by Ahri E Charm makes it easy for her to land the follow-up combo, so keep minions between you and her. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit on its return; after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path. Magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage on the return.
Ahri.build: In the early game, use a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ahri deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first, but remember it cannot block the true damage from the return of Ahri Q Orb of Deception.
Ahri.fight: Do not step forward unless the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready. When it is, look for Ahri to step up for a minion last hit, then dodge Ahri E Charm before trading. If you need to close the gap, use the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield.
Ahri.laning: Stand behind minions to avoid Ahri E Charm. While your stun is down, last-hit from the back with Annie Q Disintegrate. Once the stun is ready, wait for Ahri to step forward for a last hit.
Ahri.combo: Against one target, open with the stun from Annie P Pyromania on Annie Q Disintegrate, your longest-range ability, then use Annie W Incinerate and an auto attack during the stun. If several enemies are grouped for an engage, prepare the stun and open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Ahri.escape: Right after dodging Ahri E Charm is your chance to close in. Ahri can use the movement speed from Ahri W Fox-Fire to create distance, so use Annie E Molten Shield to get within range.
Ahri.phase: Engaging becomes harder for Annie late game, so build on the lead gained earlier.
Ahri.teamfight: Prepare the stun from Annie P Pyromania and dodge Ahri E Charm. When two or three enemies are grouped and your allies are close enough to follow up immediately, engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers. You can position the summoned Tibbers in front of your team.

Akali.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Get magic resistance and health against Akali's damage. Akali has relatively high magic resistance, so include magic penetration in Annie's build.
Akali.fight: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, look for Akali to step up for a minion last hit or emerge from the smoke. Do not step forward without the stun.
Akali.laning: While your stun is down, last-hit minions from the back with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Once the stun is ready, wait for Akali's last-hit animation before trading.
Akali.combo: Against one target, open with the stun from Annie P Pyromania on the long-range Annie Q Disintegrate, then use Annie W Incinerate and an auto attack during the stun. If several enemies are grouped and your allies can join immediately, prepare the stun and open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Akali.escape: Do not engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down. Even during that window, do not step forward unless the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready.
Akali.phase: Annie's short range and lack of a mobility ability make engaging harder late game, so build on the lead gained before then.
Akali.teamfight: Prepare the stun from Annie P Pyromania. When two or three enemies are grouped and your allies are close enough to follow up immediately, engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers. Position Tibbers in front of your team to deter Akali's engage.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range each time it hits a minion, so stay alert even behind the wave and dodge both passes. If you are low on health and the targeting indicator for Akshan R Comeuppance appears, hide behind terrain or group with allies to block the shots.
Akshan.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Akshan's main damage is physical, so build armor first.
Akshan.fight: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, trade as Akshan steps forward for a last hit. Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing has been fully spent, use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to close the gap.
Akshan.laning: When your stun is down, last-hit from the back with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Akshan Q Avengerang gains range when it hits minions, so do not rely on standing behind the wave to avoid his poke. Once your stun is ready, look for Akshan's last-hit animation.
Akshan.combo: If you open with Annie W Incinerate, its short range may let Akshan escape while you close in.
Akshan.escape: Right after Akshan E Heroic Swing has been fully spent is your window to engage. Prepare the stun from Annie P Pyromania, then use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to approach.
Akshan.phase: Akshan is weak in early auto-attack trades, but Annie should still last-hit and avoid stepping forward without her stun. Annie's short range and lack of a mobility ability make engaging harder late game, so build on the lead gained before then.
Akshan.teamfight: If Akshan has killed one of Annie's allies and gained a Scoundrel mark, do not face him alone; fight outside his finishing range. When your stun is ready, two or three enemies are grouped, and your allies can follow up immediately, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.

Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup for Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and leave its area. Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam deals more damage at the edge, so dodge the first hit or, if that is difficult, move closer to her. Ambessa R Public Execution hits the farthest enemy champion along its line, so do not line up with your team's backline.
Ambessa.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa deals mostly physical damage, so shore up Annie's low armor first. Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid building only a large amount of health.
Ambessa.fight: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, look for Ambessa's last-hit animation or the moment just after she has used all her abilities. Without the stun, stay back to account for her dashes.
Ambessa.laning: While your stun is down, last-hit minions from the back with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Annie E Molten Shield can also add a stack without consuming the stun.
Ambessa.combo: If several enemies are grouped for an engage, open with the stun from Annie P Pyromania on Annie R Summon: Tibbers, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate. Do not attack when you see Ambessa W Repudiation wind up.
Ambessa.escape: Engage right after Ambessa has used all her abilities and spent the charge on her empowered auto attack. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, do not wait for the slow to end; immediately use the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to create distance.
Ambessa.phase: Engaging becomes harder for Annie late game, so build on the lead gained in mid game.
Ambessa.teamfight: Prepare the stun from Annie P Pyromania, then open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when two or three enemies, including Ambessa, are grouped and your allies can follow up immediately. Position yourself so your team's backline is not at the far end of the line of Ambessa R Public Execution.

AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health. If it keeps hitting the same target, it deals bonus damage and grants Stardust, so stand behind minions and leave its line of fire quickly. If caught in Aurelion Sol E Singularity, walk out immediately; when low on health, avoid even its edge because it can execute you. Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend applies area crowd control. With enough Stardust, it also knocks enemies up and sends out a shockwave, so spread out from allies later in the game.
AurelionSol.build: Start with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Aurelion Sol deals mostly magic damage and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, so do not rely on stacking health alone.
AurelionSol.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, trade as Aurelion Sol steps up to last-hit a minion. Stay back without the stun. After Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is used, close the gap with the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield and counterattack.
AurelionSol.laning: While your stun is unavailable, stay back and last-hit with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Once it is ready, look for the moment Aurelion Sol steps up to last-hit. Manage your distance and his line of fire from behind minions so you do not take pointless hits from Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light and give him permanent Stardust.
AurelionSol.combo: If several enemies are grouped where your allies can follow up, ready your stun and engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then use Annie W Incinerate followed by Annie Q Disintegrate. Using Annie E Molten Shield for movement speed just before engaging does not consume a ready stun.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment after you force out Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is a chance to close the gap. Annie has no mobility spell to escape after engaging, so stay out if Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend could trap you. Engage when your stun is ready and your allies can join immediately.
AurelionSol.phase: Aurelion Sol is weakest early, before he has Stardust. Pressure his last-hits with the stun from Annie P Pyromania to slow his growth. Later, the Stardust gained through Aurelion Sol P Cosmic Creator remains permanently and makes him stronger, so build on the lead gained before then.
AurelionSol.teamfight: If the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready and several enemies, including Aurelion Sol, are grouped, engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers from a position where your allies can follow immediately. Keep your team spread out in narrow passages so multiple allies are not hit by Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Anivia.watch: Even if you leave the flight path of Anivia Q Flash Frost, its recast explosion can stun you, so keep your distance outside its range from the start. Being hit by Anivia Q Flash Frost or standing in a fully formed Anivia R Glacial Storm increases the damage from Anivia E Frostbite. Use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to leave the storm. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape.
Anivia.fight: Close the gap when the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready and Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia W Crystallize have been used. Approach with the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield, but stay back without your stun. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, engage with allies who can break the egg. If it has already been used, use that window as a kill opportunity.
Anivia.laning: While your stun is unavailable, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Once it is ready, look for Anivia stepping up to last-hit, while watching the range of Anivia Q Flash Frost and whether Anivia W Crystallize could block your escape.
Anivia.combo: Against one target, open with a stunning Annie Q Disintegrate, then use Annie W Incinerate and a basic attack during the stun. In a teamfight where several enemies are grouped, ready the stun from Annie P Pyromania and use Annie R Summon: Tibbers first for an area stun, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility spell, so the window to approach comes after Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia W Crystallize have been used. Close the gap with the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield, but engage only when allies can follow immediately, since Annie also has no escape spell. Save Flash if Anivia W Crystallize could separate you from your allies in a narrow path.
Anivia.phase: Engaging becomes harder for Annie later in the game, and Anivia's terrain control becomes troublesome, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Anivia.teamfight: Ready the stun from Annie P Pyromania in an open area. After Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia W Crystallize have been used, engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers if two or three enemies are grouped. Start from a position where your allies can follow immediately.
Anivia.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Anivia's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, consider buying a Quicksilver Sash between core items so you can remove one crowd control effect after engaging.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, with more return damage the lower your health. If cursed, move out of the straight line between you and Aurora; if your health is borderline, retreat before the return hit. While Aurora W Across the Veil keeps her invisible, do not rush to use Annie Q Disintegrate.
Aurora.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Aurora's primarily magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Aurora.fight: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, look for the moment Aurora steps up to last-hit a minion. Use the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield against her poke. If you are low on health and affected by Aurora Q Twofold Hex, retreat instead of continuing the trade.
Aurora.laning: Without a stun, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Annie E Molten Shield can also add a stack without consuming a stun. Once your stun is ready, look for Aurora's last-hit animation, and keep the stun ready when you push the wave and move elsewhere.
Aurora.combo: If Aurora uses Aurora W Across the Veil to turn invisible, wait until she reappears before using Annie Q Disintegrate.
Aurora.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Aurora W Across the Veil has been used. Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora R Between Worlds also provide mobility, so look to engage after she has used several mobility spells and the forced movement from Aurora Q Twofold Hex. The window before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up is especially good.
Aurora.phase: Engaging becomes harder for Annie later in the game, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Aurora.teamfight: Ready your stun from a position where allies can follow immediately. If two or three enemies are grouped, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun. If Aurora leaps in but does not contribute to a takedown, look for a chance to kill her then.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, move out of range until the poison ends. Repeated hits from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang while you are poisoned deal more damage and heal Cassiopeia. If you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn your back to avoid the stun.
Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia deals mostly magic damage and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads.
Cassiopeia.fight: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, take a short trade as Cassiopeia steps up to last-hit a minion. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, stop fighting and close the gap again after the poison ends.
Cassiopeia.laning: Without a stun, stay back and last-hit with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Once your stun is ready, look for Cassiopeia's last-hit animation, and keep your stun stacks when you push the wave and move elsewhere.
Cassiopeia.combo: When engaging on several enemies, ready your stun and use Annie R Summon: Tibbers first for an area stun, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility spell, so the moment after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere is a chance to close the gap. If you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn your back instead of trying to deal damage face-to-face. Use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to leave Cassiopeia W Miasma.
Cassiopeia.phase: Cassiopeia's sustained damage is strong later in the game, so wait for an opening to engage instead of pushing straight into her.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: If Cassiopeia W Miasma has been used elsewhere and your allies can follow immediately, engage with a stunning Annie R Summon: Tibbers.

Azir.watch: Do not stand in line with the soldiers Azir W Arise! summons. Move around them to approach Azir himself. Watch for the slow from Azir Q Conquering Sands and the knockback from Azir R Emperor's Divide, and do not enter a narrow passage as a group.
Azir.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Azir deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Azir.fight: Trade in short bursts when the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready. After Azir moves his soldiers with Azir Q Conquering Sands, close the gap with the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield when the soldiers have stopped or Azir E Shifting Sands is down.
Azir.laning: Without a stun, stay back, last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate, and build stacks. When the stun is ready, look for the moment Azir steps forward to last-hit.
Azir.combo: If several enemies are grouped and your team can follow up immediately, open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers while the stun is ready to stun them all, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Azir.escape: Right after Azir E Shifting Sands is used is your chance to close the gap and catch him. If he places a soldier near a wall to prepare an escape, block that direction. Stand in the path of Azir E Shifting Sands to take advantage of the dash stopping when it collides with a champion.
Azir.phase: Annie's burst is strongest in the mid game with two or three ability power items, so pressure Azir before he grows stronger over time. Annie has a harder time engaging late, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Azir.teamfight: Approach from different directions in an open area so Azir R Emperor's Divide does not push several of you back together. Open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when your stun is ready, two or three enemies are grouped, and your team can follow up.

Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages units around the first target hit, so do not hide behind minions; move out of range. Reposition especially to avoid taking the third missile in a row. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance when it hits, so move to the side instead of standing in front of him.
Corki.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki's main damage is physical, and Annie has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Resistances cannot prevent the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions; prioritize getting out of range of Corki E Gatling Gun.
Corki.fight: Do not step forward unless the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready. When it is, look for the moment Corki steps forward to last-hit. Once Corki W Valkyrie is down, use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to close the gap and stun him. Do not force an approach while Corki W Valkyrie is available.
Corki.laning: Without a stun, stay back, last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate, and build stacks. When the stun is ready, pressure Corki as he steps forward to last-hit. Disrupt his farming during the first five levels, and do not spend your stun on clearing the wave when you push it to roam.
Corki.combo: If you start with Annie W Incinerate, its short range may let Corki escape while you close the gap. When several enemies are grouped in a fight, have your stun ready and use Annie R Summon: Tibbers to stun them all, then use Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Corki.escape: Right after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie is your chance to go in. If Corki W Valkyrie is still available, he can escape over terrain. Confirm it is down, then close the gap when the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready.
Corki.phase: Corki has low base stats during the first five levels, so use your stun to pressure his farming. Annie has a harder time engaging late, and Corki grows stronger as he gets items, so build on the lead you gained before then.
Corki.teamfight: Prepare the stun from Annie P Pyromania, then engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when two or three enemies, including Corki, are grouped and your team can follow up immediately.

Ekko.build: Build magic resistance first to handle Ekko's damage. Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive early, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Ekko.fight: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, look for the moment Ekko steps forward to last-hit. Do not step forward without the stun.
Ekko.laning: Without a stun, stay back, last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate, and build stacks. Annie E Molten Shield can also add a stack without consuming the stun. When you see the indicator for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, stay out of its area, and avoid the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder.
Ekko.combo: To catch Ekko alone, start with a stun from Annie Q Disintegrate, then use Annie W Incinerate and an auto attack while he is stunned. You can use Annie E Molten Shield while approaching or cast it on Tibbers immediately after summoning him.
Ekko.phase: Annie's burst is strongest in the mid game with two or three ability power items, so build on the lead you gain then. Her short range and lack of mobility make engaging harder late, so avoid forcing the first engage.
Ekko.teamfight: Prepare the stun from Annie P Pyromania and avoid the area of Ekko W Parallel Convergence. If two or three enemies are grouped where your team can follow up, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers to stun them all.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, don't chase too far, since Ekko can escape with Ekko R Chronobreak. Fight in earnest when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Watch the direction Ekko Q Timewinder travels and dodge its return path too. If you see the afterimage from Ekko R Chronobreak, don't chase recklessly, even at low health.

Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike travels in an arc and applies a mark, so dodge sideways rather than retreating in a straight line. If it marks you, the cooldown of Diana E Lunar Rush may reset; use the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to create distance. Right after Diana activates Diana W Pale Cascade, wait for its orbs and shield to disappear before fighting.
Diana.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Diana deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Diana.fight: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, look for the moment Diana steps forward to last-hit a minion. Fight after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade are gone, and do not step forward without a stun. If Diana Q Crescent Strike marks you, create distance instead of trying to catch her.
Diana.laning: Stay behind the wave while your stun is unavailable. When it is ready, harass Diana as she last-hits.
Diana.combo: When engaging on several enemies, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers to stun them all, then use Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate. Annie E Molten Shield does not consume the stun, so you can use it to approach or avoid Diana's poke.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, you have a chance to catch her with the stun from Annie P Pyromania. You can also close the gap or catch her right after forcing her to use Diana E Lunar Rush. If you have been marked, though, Diana E Lunar Rush can be used again, so back off instead of engaging.
Diana.phase: Annie's short range and lack of mobility make engaging difficult late, so build on your earlier lead during the mid game.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from your teammates so Diana R Moonfall does not pull several of you together, and use vision to check angles for a flank. When your team can follow up immediately and two or three enemies are grouped, engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers while your stun is ready.

Fizz.watch: Fizz Q Urchin Strike and Fizz E Playful / Trickster are both used to engage, so do not move close just because one is down. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.
Fizz.build: Fizz deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Fizz.fight: Do not move forward unless the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready.
Fizz.laning: Last-hit minions from behind with Annie Q Disintegrate while building stacks of Annie P Pyromania. Taking one early point in Annie E Molten Shield lets you build stacks during a standoff without consuming the stun.
Fizz.combo: When targeting multiple enemies, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers first with your stun ready to stun them in an area, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate, in that order.
Fizz.escape: The clearest opening to engage is right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster goes on cooldown. Check that Fizz Q Urchin Strike is also down before going in to reduce his chance of escaping with his remaining mobility. If Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, first move away from your allies and position to dodge the shark.
Fizz.phase: Annie has a harder time engaging late because of her range and lack of mobility, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay close to your allies, draw out Fizz E Playful / Trickster, then focus him down.

Galio.watch: When Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, he takes less damage and his taunt lasts longer, so hold your damage and move out of taunt range. Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see him pull back to wind up, and avoid the point where the two gusts from Galio Q Winds of War meet. If the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance appears, immediately walk out of its area.
Galio.build: Galio deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Galio builds magic resistance, consider magic penetration too.
Galio.fight: Do not move forward when the stun from Annie P Pyromania is not ready. Keeping your distance comes first because you need to avoid Galio's abilities that can catch you.
Galio.laning: When your stun is not ready, last-hit minions from behind the wave with Annie Q Disintegrate while building stacks. Make Galio use abilities to clear the wave, then push during the window after he has spent mana to give him less room to affect other lanes with Galio R Hero's Entrance. When roaming, push the wave without using your ready stun to clear it.
Galio.combo: When multiple enemies are grouped in a fight, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers first with your stun ready to stun them in an area, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate, in that order. If you need to close the distance, use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield.
Galio.escape: Do not go in just because Galio E Justice Punch is down. Look for an opening after you have dodged or drawn out the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand and the knockup from Galio E Justice Punch, while Galio R Hero's Entrance is still on cooldown. Annie has no ability to escape on her own, so keep your distance outside that opening.
Galio.phase: Annie has a harder time engaging late, so build on the lead you gained before then.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready, do not be the first to start a skirmish against Galio's team in another lane. In teamfights, avoid the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance. Engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when your stun is ready, multiple enemies are grouped, and your allies can follow up immediately.

Hwei.watch: If the root or pull from Hwei E Subject: Torment catches you, his follow-up attacks are easy to land, so do not move close first while that ability is available. If an initial attack such as Hwei Q Subject: Disaster hits you, use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to reposition immediately and dodge the second attack.
Hwei.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance, and get tenacity to help against the crowd control from Hwei E Subject: Torment.
Hwei.fight: Do not move forward unless the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready.
Hwei.laning: While your stun is not ready, last-hit minions from behind with Annie Q Disintegrate and build stacks.
Hwei.combo: When multiple enemies are grouped in a fight, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers first with your stun ready to stun them in an area, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility ability, so look to go in right after he uses Hwei E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave. If that ability is still available, wait: its root or forced movement can stop your engage.
Hwei.phase: Your burst is strongest in the mid game with two or three ability power items, so build on the lead you gain then. Engaging gets harder late because of Annie's range and lack of mobility, so do not force the first engage.
Hwei.teamfight: Ready the stun from Annie P Pyromania. After Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when multiple enemies are grouped and your allies can follow up immediately.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can bring her toward you through repeated dashes to low-health minions, so back away when minions are about to die. Watch for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you are trapped inside the barrier from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Annie has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Irelia.fight: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, look to trade as Irelia steps up to last-hit a minion. If Irelia Q Bladesurge or Irelia E Flawless Duet is down, use the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to close the distance.
Irelia.laning: When your stun is not ready, last-hit from behind the wave with Annie Q Disintegrate while building stacks. Do not leave low-health minions between you and Irelia. Once your stun is ready, trade when she steps up to last-hit.
Irelia.escape: Irelia Q Bladesurge is Irelia's way to move around, so right after she uses it is an opening to close the distance. If Irelia E Flawless Duet is also down and the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, activate Annie E Molten Shield and engage.
Irelia.phase: Annie's short range and limited mobility make engaging harder late, so build on your earlier lead in the mid game.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia because she can split up the fight with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and stun multiple allies with Irelia E Flawless Duet. Ready the stun from Annie P Pyromania, then engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when enemies are grouped and your allies can follow up immediately. If there is no opening to engage, stay in front of your team's carry, stun Irelia to stop her from reaching them, and cast Annie E Molten Shield on your ally.

Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere grants a shield that absorbs magic damage, so poke with Annie Q Disintegrate after the shield is gone.
Kassadin.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance.
Kassadin.fight: Trade when Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready and the shield from Kassadin Q Null Sphere is gone. If you need to close the gap, use Annie E Molten Shield for its shield and movement speed, but avoid using unnecessary abilities near Kassadin and speeding up the next use of Kassadin E Force Pulse.
Kassadin.laning: Do not move forward when your stun is unavailable.
Kassadin.combo: Once the shield from Kassadin Q Null Sphere is gone and Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, stun with Annie Q Disintegrate, then use Annie W Incinerate and a basic attack.
Kassadin.phase: Late game, watch for Kassadin R Riftwalk to bring him in from behind, and do not stand alone.
Kassadin.teamfight: Ready Annie P Pyromania's stun, then use Annie R Summon: Tibbers to stun multiple enemies when they are grouped and your allies are close enough to follow up immediately.

Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame deals area damage and slows, so stand behind minions or outside its range to avoid it. If Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra hits you, immediately leave the lingering area too. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, move far enough away before it roots you.
Karma.build: Early on, use Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Karma's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots and build magic resistance first. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, prioritize moving far enough away to break it rather than relying on your resistance.
Karma.fight: Trade when Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready and Karma steps up to last-hit a minion. Use the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to approach, but keep your distance first if Karma W Focused Resolve is available. If the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra is active, wait until it ends before using your burst.
Karma.laning: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is unavailable, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Annie E Molten Shield can also build a stack without consuming a ready stun.
Karma.combo: To target multiple enemies, ready your stun, then use Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, followed by Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate. You can use Annie E Molten Shield to approach before engaging; it does not consume a ready stun.
Karma.escape: Draw out Karma W Focused Resolve before engaging. If the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra is active, wait for it to expire. If Karma W Focused Resolve has already connected, move far enough away to break it before the root, then look for another opportunity.
Karma.phase: Annie has a harder time engaging late game, so build on the lead gained earlier.
Karma.teamfight: Engage after Karma W Focused Resolve has been used and the shield from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra has ended, from a position where your allies can follow up immediately. If Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers to stun two or three grouped enemies, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.

Leblanc.watch: If the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice is still on you, her next ability will deal more damage, so back off until the mark disappears. Watch both the range from which LeBlanc W Distortion can reach you and the range of LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. If the chain hits you, move far enough away before it roots you.
Leblanc.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand her damage and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. LeBlanc deals mostly magic damage, and Annie's magic resistance is relatively low, so prioritize magic resistance.
Leblanc.fight: Do not move forward unless the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready. When it is ready, look for the moment LeBlanc steps up to last-hit a minion. Close the gap and counterattack after the return from LeBlanc W Distortion has expired or been used.
Leblanc.laning: While your stun is unavailable, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Annie E Molten Shield can also build a stack without consuming a ready stun. If LeBlanc pushes the wave and disappears from vision, alert your team immediately.
Leblanc.combo: If multiple enemies are grouped, ready your stun and open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then use Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate in that order.
Leblanc.escape: Right after you force LeBlanc to use LeBlanc W Distortion is a chance to close the gap, but while she can still return, check whether that return has expired or been used. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains has also been used, ready the stun from Annie P Pyromania and engage. If the chain hits you, prioritize getting away before it roots you.
Leblanc.phase: Early on, look for moments when your stun is ready; otherwise, last-hit safely. Engaging gets harder late game, so build on the lead gained before then.
Leblanc.teamfight: Ready the stun from Annie P Pyromania and, when two or three enemies are grouped, open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers from a position where your allies can follow up immediately.

Lissandra.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items and use it to remove one crowd control effect after engaging.
Lissandra.fight: Do not move forward unless Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready. Trade right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses, when Lissandra steps up to last-hit a minion. After Lissandra uses E Glacial Path, look for a chance to close the gap with the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield.
Lissandra.laning: Without Annie P Pyromania's stun, last-hit from behind with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Once the stun is ready, look for the moment Lissandra steps forward to last-hit.
Lissandra.combo: If you can hit multiple enemies, lead with Annie R Summon: Tibbers to apply your prepared stun, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Lissandra.escape: Right after Lissandra E Glacial Path has been fully spent is your window to close the gap and engage. At low levels, you can also trade right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses. Even when both windows open, do not force an engage unless Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready.
Lissandra.phase: Early on, Annie can use her stun, but while it is unavailable, farm carefully around Lissandra's root and stun. Later, Annie's short range and lack of mobility make engaging harder, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Lissandra.teamfight: Prepare Annie P Pyromania's stun and check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path has been used. Engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when two or three enemies are grouped and your allies can follow up immediately. If you summoned Annie R Summon: Tibbers earlier, keep Tibbers in front of your team.
Lissandra.watch: If you're rooted by Lissandra W Ring of Frost or stunned by Lissandra R Frozen Tomb, you're likely to take follow-up damage, so keep your distance while both abilities are available. If Lissandra can cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, don't dump all your damage at once; spread it out until her stasis ends.

Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding catches you, you may take several follow-up abilities, so bait it out and dodge sideways. It can root up to two targets, so avoid standing in a line with an ally. If a Lux ability hits you, back away to avoid the basic attack that triggers the Lux P Illumination mark. Move sideways when you see the targeting line for Lux R Final Spark.
Lux.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Lux deals mainly magic damage, so shore up Annie's low magic resistance first.
Lux.fight: Do not move forward unless Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready. Once it is ready, bait and dodge Lux Q Light Binding, then close the gap using the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield. Lux has no mobility ability, so she has trouble escaping once you reach her.
Lux.laning: Without a stun, last-hit minions from behind with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Once the stun is ready, look for Lux stepping forward to last-hit, but dodge Lux Q Light Binding before trading. When pushing the wave before moving elsewhere, avoid using your stun to clear it.
Lux.combo: To pick off Lux alone, start with Annie Q Disintegrate when your stun is ready, then use Annie W Incinerate and a basic attack while she is rooted. When multiple enemies are grouped in a fight, have your stun ready and open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers to stun them in an area, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate, in that order.
Lux.escape: Right after Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to engage. Lux has no mobility ability, so prepare Annie P Pyromania's stun and close the gap with Annie E Molten Shield.
Lux.phase: Annie's burst is strongest in the mid game after she has two or three ability power items, so build on the advantage you gain after dodging Lux Q Light Binding. Engaging becomes harder later, so do not push too far forward.
Lux.teamfight: Engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when your allies can follow up immediately.

Mel.watch: A hit from the center of Mel E Solar Snare roots you and makes it easy for Mel Q Radiant Volley to hit you next, so dodge sideways. Mel W Rebuttal reflects projectiles for a brief moment, so bait it out with a basic attack before using your main abilities. If repeated hits from Mel have built up Overwhelm stacks, retreat even if you still have health. Wait somewhere safe until the stacks disappear to guard against Mel R Golden Eclipse.
Mel.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Mel's magic damage early. Choose Mercury's Treads and prioritize magic resistance.
Mel.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, look for Mel stepping forward to last-hit a minion. If you dodge Mel E Solar Snare sideways and Mel W Rebuttal has been used, close the gap with the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield and attack. Do not move forward without a stun.
Mel.laning: Without a stun, last-hit minions from behind with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Once the stun is ready, pressure Mel as she moves to last-hit. Push the wave or pressure her early to give her less room to scale. Use Annie W Incinerate when you need to push the wave or have a clear chance to kill.
Mel.combo: When multiple enemies are grouped in a fight, prepare your stun and lead with Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility ability, so look for a chance to close the gap when you have dodged Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal is down. Use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to engage, but stay out if your stun is not ready.
Mel.phase: Early on, Annie can create kill opportunities with her stun, so pressure Mel to slow her scaling. Mel grows stronger as she builds up, while Annie has a harder time engaging later, so build on your early advantage.
Mel.teamfight: Prepare your stun, then engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when two or three enemies, including Mel, are grouped together and your allies are positioned to follow up immediately.

Naafiri.watch: If the first hit of Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers lands, keep your distance until the bleed ends to avoid the second hit. When Naafiri closes in with E Eviscerate, create distance with the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield. Do not travel alone while Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit is available.
Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, and Annie has low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. If fights last long enough for the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate to become a problem, consider healing reduction after building resistances.
Naafiri.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, look for Naafiri stepping up to last-hit a minion. After Naafiri E Eviscerate has been used, clear the revived pack with Annie W Incinerate and counterattack. Do not step forward to trade without a stun.
Naafiri.laning: Use your range to harass melee Naafiri, but do not give her an opening to close in with Naafiri E Eviscerate. When your stun is ready, trade only as she steps up to last-hit.
Naafiri.combo: In teamfights, prepare Annie P Pyromania's stun and use Annie R Summon: Tibbers to stun multiple enemies, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Naafiri.escape: Do not engage immediately just because Naafiri E Eviscerate has been used. If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers has been fully spent, Naafiri E Eviscerate has also been used, and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit has not come back up, prepare your stun and engage. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, wait for it to end before using the targeted Annie Q Disintegrate.
Naafiri.phase: Early on, Annie can pressure Naafiri with her stun and range, but farm from behind when the stun is unavailable. Engaging becomes harder later, so fight as a group to keep Naafiri from picking off isolated allies.
Naafiri.teamfight: Prepare your stun where your allies can follow up immediately, and engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when multiple enemies are grouped. Right after an ally dies, Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit may become available again, so retreat to avoid successive pickoffs.

Malzahar.watch: When a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect spreads to a nearby enemy, so do not wait beside it for a last hit. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outside the line between its two portals to avoid the silence. Annie E Molten Shield cannot break Malzahar R Nether Grasp, so do not enter areas without vision alone while his R is available.
Malzahar.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Malzahar's main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it with Annie Q Disintegrate before fighting. When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, trade as Malzahar steps forward to last-hit. Do not step forward without the stun.
Malzahar.laning: While your stun is unavailable, stay back, last-hit with Annie Q Disintegrate, and build stacks. If Malzahar E Malefic Visions is on the wave, back off until the minions are cleared. When Malzahar pushes the lane, look for a chance to engage with your jungler.
Malzahar.combo: Remove Malzahar P Void Shift first and prepare Annie P Pyromania's stun. If several enemies are grouped and your team can follow up, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Malzahar.escape: Avoid the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void and close the distance when Malzahar R Nether Grasp is unavailable. If Malzahar W Void Swarm's summons are already out, clear them first with Annie W Incinerate, then use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to engage. Malzahar has no ability to create distance on his own, so you have a chance to kill him once you reach him.
Malzahar.teamfight: After removing Malzahar P Void Shift, start with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, your team can follow up, and several enemies are grouped. If Malzahar W Void Swarm's summons are out, clear them first with Annie W Incinerate.
Malzahar.phase: Pressure Malzahar early with Annie P Pyromania's stun and give him less time to build up with Malzahar W Void Swarm. Malzahar gets stronger over time, while Annie has a harder time engaging late, so build on your early lead.

Orianna.watch: When Orianna moves her ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack, move based on the ball's position rather than Orianna herself. Avoid standing near it, where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. Also watch for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance and consecutive basic attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Orianna's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and build magic resistance.
Orianna.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, trade as Orianna steps forward to last-hit or just after she sends out her ball with Orianna Q Command: Attack. If the ball is away from Orianna, she lacks the persistent armor and magic resistance from Orianna E Command: Protect, creating an opening. Use the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to approach.
Orianna.laning: Without your stun, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Once it is ready, look for Orianna's last-hit animation, but do not stand where her ball is. When pushing the wave before moving elsewhere, do not spend your prepared stun on clearing it.
Orianna.combo: To engage on several enemies, prepare your stun and use Annie R Summon: Tibbers first for an area stun, then Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Orianna.escape: Look to engage when Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down and her ball is not in a dangerous position.
Orianna.phase: Annie has a harder time engaging late, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Orianna.teamfight: Watch Orianna's ball and wait until Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready. If two or three enemies are grouped and your team is close enough to follow up immediately, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs can hit a target in front and continue to targets behind, so do not stand in line with your allies. If Neeko approaches while disguised with Neeko P Inherent Glamour, the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may be hidden; spread out as soon as a suspicious enemy gets close. Do not chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter; track the real Neeko.
Neeko.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Neeko's magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs roots you and Neeko R Pop Blossom follows, prioritize tenacity. If the enemy team has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items.
Neeko.fight: Do not step forward before Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready. Once it is ready, look for the moment Neeko steps forward to last-hit, and use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to get into attack range. Trade after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs has been used or while Neeko R Pop Blossom is unavailable.
Neeko.laning: Without your stun, stay behind the wave and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. A killing blow refunds mana and reduces its cooldown, letting you farm while preparing your stun. Once the stun is ready, wait for Neeko to step forward to last-hit.
Neeko.combo: In teamfights, prepare your stun, then use Annie R Summon: Tibbers to stun several enemies, followed by Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate. Make sure you do not consume the stun with another damaging ability before Annie R Summon: Tibbers.
Neeko.escape: You have an opening to engage just after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is used or while Neeko R Pop Blossom is unavailable. Prepare Annie P Pyromania's stun before going in. If you see Neeko R Pop Blossom's windup, use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to leave its area.
Neeko.phase: Annie has a harder time engaging late, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Neeko.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs cannot root several of you together. When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready and two or three enemies are grouped, start with Annie R Summon: Tibbers from a position where your team can follow up immediately.

Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root you when she has the river element, so move out of range first when she approaches. The shockwave from Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes when it reaches terrain, so do not stand with your back to a wall, and avoid the river and narrow passages. If Qiyana disappears while holding the brush element, move into your team's vision.
Qiyana.build: Qiyana's main damage is physical and Annie has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to withstand it. Choose Plated Steelcaps and build armor first. If the enemy team has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, fit Quicksilver Sash between your core items to remove one crowd control effect after engaging.
Qiyana.fight: Do not step forward unless Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready. Trade when both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity have been used and Qiyana remains in front of you. When engaging, use Annie E Molten Shield for its shield and movement speed, and make sure your team is close enough to follow up immediately.
Qiyana.laning: Without your stun, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Once it is ready, look for Qiyana stepping forward to last-hit, but keep your distance if she still has a way to engage. When pushing the wave before roaming, do not spend your prepared stun on clearing it.
Qiyana.combo: If Qiyana remains in front of you after using a movement ability, open with Annie Q Disintegrate, your longest-range ability, to apply the prepared Annie P Pyromania stun. In a teamfight with several enemies grouped, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers first for an area stun while your stun is ready, then Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Qiyana.escape: Do not engage just because Qiyana W Terrashape has been used. Look to counterattack right after she has used both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity, especially before Qiyana E Audacity is available again. Keep your distance first if you are positioned where the root from Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal or the stun from Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent is a threat.
Qiyana.phase: Both champions are strong in the mid game, so build armor without giving Qiyana an early or mid game lead. Qiyana becomes relatively weaker late, but Annie also has a harder time engaging, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Qiyana.teamfight: Prepare your stun, and when two or three enemies are grouped, start with Annie R Summon: Tibbers from a position where your team can follow up. Even when grouped with your allies, stand away from terrain to avoid Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.

Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, stay away from allies until the mark expires. Once marked, Ryze Q Overload is empowered and spreads to nearby targets, and Ryze W Rune Prison roots instead of slowing. Dodge Ryze E Spell Flux first.
Ryze.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Ryze deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance early.
Ryze.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, look for the moment Ryze steps forward to last-hit a minion. Absorb poke from Ryze E Spell Flux with Annie E Molten Shield and use its movement speed to close the gap. Do not step forward without the stun.
Ryze.laning: Early Ryze lacks mana and damage, so pressure him when your stun is ready to slow his growth. Until then, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Do not spend the stun on clearing the wave, even when you plan to push and move.
Ryze.combo: In a teamfight where several enemies are grouped, ready your stun, then open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun. Follow with Annie W Incinerate, then Annie Q Disintegrate.
Ryze.escape: If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison can only slow you, so look to engage then too. If Ryze is casting Ryze R Realm Warp, you can interrupt him with a ready stun.
Ryze.phase: Engaging becomes harder for Annie late game, so build on the leads you gained before then.
Ryze.teamfight: If your stun is ready, two or three enemies including Ryze are grouped, and your allies can follow up immediately, open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers.

Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, the chain he throws after the first dash is more dangerous than the dash itself. Use Annie E Molten Shield on the first dash for movement speed and make room to dodge the chain. If Sylas Q Chain Lash clips you, immediately leave the spot where its chains cross. Sylas W Kingslayer heals him more when his health is low, so do not delay the finish for long after bringing his health down.
Sylas.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Sylas deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance early.
Sylas.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready and Sylas comes forward to last-hit a minion, trade with him. Without the stun, do not step forward; dodge the chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, then look for another opening. Just before engaging, use Annie E Molten Shield for movement speed to get in range for Annie W Incinerate and Annie R Summon: Tibbers.
Sylas.laning: While your stun is unavailable, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. When pushing the wave before moving, do not spend your ready stun on wave clear.
Sylas.combo: When targeting several enemies, ready your stun and open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then use Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate. Annie E Molten Shield does not consume the stun, so you can use it before engaging.
Sylas.escape: Do not engage just because you have seen the first dash of Sylas E Abscond / Abduct. Dodge the follow-up chain, then decide whether to go in. Sylas can also escape with Sylas W Kingslayer, so do not force an engage if only one of his movement abilities is down. In particular, look for a chance before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is available again.
Sylas.phase: Engaging becomes harder for Annie late game, so build on earlier leads during the mid game.
Sylas.teamfight: When Sylas jumps in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, stun him with Annie P Pyromania and take him down before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. If several enemies are grouped and your allies can follow up immediately, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then land Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.

Syndra.watch: If a Syndra Q Dark Sphere lies between Syndra and Annie, move out of its line: Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push it into you and stun you. Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak are placed or thrown, so walk out of their telegraphed areas. Watch for Syndra R Unleashed Power where several spheres are on the ground, and if your health is low, move away before it executes you.
Syndra.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Syndra's primary magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Get movement speed early to dodge Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Magic resistance does not reduce the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will, so keep an eye on your total health too.
Syndra.fight: Do not step forward unless Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready. Once it is ready, look to trade when Syndra comes forward to last-hit. If Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to close the gap.
Syndra.laning: Without a stun, stay back in lane and last-hit with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Annie E Molten Shield does not consume the stun, so use it to build stacks during a standoff. Once the stun is ready, look for Syndra's last-hit animation and stand clear of the line of her spheres.
Syndra.combo: To pick off Syndra alone, start with Annie Q Disintegrate, Annie’s longest-range ability, carrying the stun from Annie P Pyromania. Once Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, use Annie E Molten Shield to close the gap and attack in that order.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her only self-defense tool and has a long cooldown, so immediately after she uses it is your chance to engage. Syndra has no movement ability to escape once you close the gap, but check that Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready before going in.
Syndra.phase: Annie's burst is strongest in the mid game with two or three ability power items, so build on leads then. Late game, her short range and lack of a movement ability make engaging harder; do not force the first engage.
Syndra.teamfight: Ready Annie P Pyromania's stun. If two or three enemies including Syndra are grouped, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then land Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate. Check where Syndra has placed several spheres and whether Syndra E Scatter the Weak has been used, and start from a position where your allies can follow up immediately. If there is no opening to engage, guard the space in front of your allied carry and cast Annie E Molten Shield on them.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, stay outside his basic attack range; one hit will stun you. Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards is area poke, so stand behind minions to reduce the damage you take.
TwistedFate.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Twisted Fate deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance early.
TwistedFate.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, look for the moment Twisted Fate steps forward to last-hit a minion. If he is holding a gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, keep your distance. Immediately after he uses the card, use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to close in. Do not step forward if your stun is not ready.
TwistedFate.laning: While your stun is unavailable, stay back and last-hit with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Annie E Molten Shield can also build a stack without consuming the stun.
TwistedFate.combo: Against one target, open with a stun on Annie Q Disintegrate, then use Annie W Incinerate and a basic attack while the target is stunned. If several enemies are grouped for an engage, put the stun on Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate. Before engaging, check that the stun is ready and has not been consumed by another damaging ability.
TwistedFate.escape: Immediately after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your chance to close in. Annie has no movement ability to escape after engaging, so do not force an engage while the enemy still has a stun available.
TwistedFate.phase: Annie can use her stun early, but farm from behind when it is unavailable. Her burst is strongest in the mid game with two or three ability power items, so build on your leads then. Late game, choose your engages carefully given her short range and lack of a movement ability.
TwistedFate.teamfight: If Twisted Fate has used the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card and two or three enemies are grouped, open with a ready stun on Annie R Summon: Tibbers from a position where your allies can follow up immediately. If you see Twisted Fate activate Twisted Fate R Destiny within range, interrupt his travel with a stun.

Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you on the way out, move out of its return path to avoid the second hit and the Talon P Blade's End follow-up. Do not force a chase while Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy's dash and Talon R Shadow Assault's stealth are available.
Talon.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Talon's damage is physical, so prioritize armor; add health once he builds flat penetration. Annie's magic damage can be blunted by Talon's high magic resistance, so build magic penetration.
Talon.fight: Do not step forward unless Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready. Once Talon R Shadow Assault has also been used, it is a good time to counterattack.
Talon.laning: Without a stun, stay back and last-hit with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. When the stun is ready, catch Talon as he moves to last-hit. Talon can roam over terrain, so share his location and keep vision along jungle paths.
Talon.combo: When several enemies are grouped in a fight, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers first with your stun ready to stun them in an area, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Talon.escape: Right after you draw out Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your chance to close the gap. If he has already used Talon R Shadow Assault too, stun him while he cannot escape through stealth. Use Annie E Molten Shield's movement speed before going in.
Talon.phase: Talon's impact falls off late, but engaging also gets harder for Annie, so build on your mid-game lead.
Talon.teamfight: Engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when your stun is ready, two or three enemies are grouped, and your team can follow immediately. If Talon dives your backline, stay grouped with your team and layer your crowd control.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge. If trapped inside, move within it instead of running into the edge, and wait for it to disappear. Dodge Veigar W Dark Matter sideways when you see its ground indicator. If you are below half health, stay out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which gets stronger based on your missing health.
Veigar.build: Veigar deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and build magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If the enemy has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, fit Quicksilver Sash between core items so you can remove one crowd control effect after engaging.
Veigar.fight: With Annie P Pyromania's stun ready, catch Veigar as he steps forward to last-hit a minion. Keep moving during trades to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter, and use Annie E Molten Shield's movement speed to get into attack range.
Veigar.laning: Without a stun, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Try to disrupt Veigar's farming early.
Veigar.combo: When targeting several enemies, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers first with your stun ready to stun them in an area, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate, in that order.
Veigar.escape: Engage after Veigar E Event Horizon has been used. Veigar has no ability to create distance on his own, so ready Annie P Pyromania's stun and use Annie E Molten Shield's movement speed to close the gap.
Veigar.phase: Veigar keeps getting stronger late, while engaging gets harder for Annie, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Veigar.teamfight: Check Veigar's position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon. When two or three enemies are grouped and your team is close enough to follow immediately, engage with a stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. If there is no opening to engage, guard the space in front of your team's carry, stun enemies who get onto them, and cast Annie E Molten Shield on that ally.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so avoid standing in line with the minion wave and sidestep it. If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave it immediately instead of continuing to trade inside it, so you avoid the stun.
Viktor.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Viktor's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, and prioritize magic resistance over armor.
Viktor.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, trade as Viktor steps forward to last-hit a minion. Dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray and get out of Viktor W Gravity Field, then use Annie E Molten Shield's shield and movement speed to close the gap.
Viktor.laning: Without a stun, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Watch the angle of Viktor E Hextech Ray toward the wave, and do not stand in line with the minions. If you push the wave with your stun ready, you can save the stun instead of using it to clear and move to a side lane.
Viktor.combo: When targeting Viktor alone, start with a stun from Annie Q Disintegrate, then use Annie W Incinerate and a basic attack while he is stunned. When several enemies are grouped in a fight, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers first with your stun ready to stun them in an area, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate, in that order.
Viktor.escape: Engage after Viktor W Gravity Field has been used or once you are outside its area. Viktor has no dash, but account for the shield and movement speed from Viktor Q Siphon Power, and use Annie E Molten Shield to close the gap.
Viktor.phase: Pressure Viktor with your stun early, before he has built up Viktor P Glorious Evolution. Later, Viktor's scaling adds up and engaging gets harder for Annie, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Viktor.teamfight: Ready Annie P Pyromania's stun and avoid Viktor W Gravity Field. Engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when two or three enemies are grouped and your team can follow immediately.

Vex.watch: Delay your engage while Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear is ready, and look for an opening right after she uses it on the wave or to poke. Vex E Looming Darkness covers a larger area at long range, so use Annie E Molten Shield's movement speed to make a short sideways dodge. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you, move toward your team so you can respond together to her follow-up dash.
Vex.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vex deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Vex.fight: With Annie P Pyromania's stun ready, catch Vex as she steps forward to last-hit a minion. If both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and Vex W Personal Space's shield are gone, close the gap with Annie E Molten Shield and fight.
Vex.laning: Without a stun, stay back and last-hit with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Once your stun is ready, wait for Vex to step forward to last-hit. Do not force your way forward while Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear is available. Save your stun instead of using it to clear the wave when you push and roam.
Vex.combo: Look for a window when Vex cannot use Vex W Personal Space. Do not move in just to start with the short-range Annie W Incinerate.
Vex.escape: Go in after Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear has been spent on the wave or on poke and Vex W Personal Space has also been used.
Vex.phase: Engaging gets harder for Annie late, so build on the lead you gained earlier.
Vex.teamfight: Ready Annie P Pyromania's stun, then use Annie R Summon: Tibbers to stun enemies in an area when two or three are grouped and your team is close enough to follow immediately. Move any low-health ally out of Vex's range first so they do not become the first kill from Vex R Shadow Surge.

Xerath.watch: Be especially careful of Xerath E Shocking Orb's stun, which can leave you open to follow-up attacks. If you see Xerath begin casting Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, get ready to dodge immediately.
Xerath.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Xerath deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the enemy team has a lot of crowd control that prevents movement, consider Quicksilver Sash between core items to remove one crowd control effect after engaging.
Xerath.fight: Do not step forward unless Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready. Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, use Annie E Molten Shield's shield and movement speed to close the gap. Stun Xerath and trade when he steps forward to last-hit a minion.
Xerath.laning: While your stun is unavailable, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Xerath Q Arcanopulse can hit you through minions, so dodge sideways when he starts charging it. Farm while avoiding heavy damage, then push the wave and call your jungler when Xerath runs low on mana.
Xerath.combo: In teamfights, prepare your stun and open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers to stun multiple enemies, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate in that order. Annie E Molten Shield does not consume the stun, so you can use it just before engaging to close the gap.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility ability, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are used is your chance to engage. While he charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse, dodge sideways and close the gap while he is slowed. You can also engage on Xerath's position while he casts Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, since he cannot move.
Xerath.phase: Annie's short range and lack of mobility make engaging harder late in the game, so build on your mid-game lead.
Xerath.teamfight: Prepare Annie P Pyromania's stun, then engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when two or three enemies are grouped and your teammates are positioned to follow up immediately. If there is no opening to engage, stand in front of an allied carry, stun enemies who approach, and cast Annie E Molten Shield on that ally. You can also position Tibbers in front of your team ahead of time to deter enemies from approaching.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals him, becomes empowered, and increases his movement speed, so keep your distance when he approaches to use the empowered Q. When Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood, stand behind minions or move out of range. If Vladimir R Hemoplague hits you, step back until its increased damage effect ends.
Vladimir.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vladimir deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If fights run long, add healing reduction to counter Vladimir's healing.
Vladimir.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, look for the moment Vladimir steps forward to last-hit a minion. Use Annie E Molten Shield to absorb poke and gain movement speed, then get close enough to use your short-range abilities.
Vladimir.laning: When your stun is unavailable, do not step forward. Last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks.
Vladimir.combo: If you can catch multiple enemies with an engage, prepare your stun, open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Vladimir.escape: Vladimir is slowed while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, so you can use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to close the gap. If your stun is not ready, do not force your way forward even during this window.
Vladimir.phase: Engaging becomes harder for Annie late in the game, and Vladimir also becomes harder to face as he scales, so build on your earlier lead.
Vladimir.teamfight: Do not stand grouped with allies inside Vladimir R Hemoplague's area. If you are affected, join the fight after the effect ends. Once Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is down, prepare Annie P Pyromania's stun and engage with Annie R Summon: Tibbers when several enemies are grouped and your teammates are positioned to follow up immediately.

Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move outside the shadow's Zed E Shadow Slash range to avoid the slow. If Zed R Death Mark is applied to you, interrupt his combo with Annie P Pyromania's stun before he adds more damage.
Zed.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Zed's main damage is physical, so build armor early.
Zed.fight: Do not step forward when Annie P Pyromania's stun is not ready.
Zed.laning: Without your stun, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. When your stun is ready, look for the moment Zed steps forward to last-hit.
Zed.combo: If Zed engages with Zed R Death Mark, stun him while the mark is active to stop his follow-up damage.
Zed.escape: Look for an opening to engage immediately after Zed uses Zed W Living Shadow, when the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already swapped positions. If Zed also has Zed R Death Mark available, do not judge the opening solely by one mobility ability being used; look for an opening before his ultimate comes back.
Zed.phase: Build armor early to survive Zed's combo while preparing your stun. Zed becomes weaker late in the game, but engaging also becomes harder for Annie, so build on your mid-game lead.
Zed.teamfight: Prepare Annie P Pyromania's stun. When two or three enemies are grouped and your teammates can follow up immediately, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers to stun them, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.

Yone.watch: After Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, he can follow with a dash and knock-up. When the whirlwind is ready, wait out of range until the stacks expire. If Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, holding Annie P Pyromania's stun can prevent his return. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies it hits and moves him behind the last champion, so before a teamfight, check that you are not standing alone at the very back of your formation.
Yone.fight: When Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready and Yone steps forward to last-hit a minion, stun him first with Annie Q Disintegrate, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and a basic attack. Without your stun, do not step forward. If Yone approaches, use Annie E Molten Shield's shield and movement speed to create distance.
Yone.laning: When your stun is unavailable or Yone Q Mortal Steel's whirlwind is ready, stay out of the middle of the lane and last-hit from behind.
Yone.combo: When targeting Yone alone, prepare Annie P Pyromania's stun and open with the longer-range Annie Q Disintegrate. In a fight where multiple enemies are grouped, open with Annie R Summon: Tibbers while your stun is ready to stun them, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.
Yone.escape: Annie's chance to engage comes after Yone Q Mortal Steel's whirlwind has disappeared and Yone E Soul Unbound and Yone R Fate Sealed are down. If only one mobility ability is down, he can escape with the other, so prepare Annie P Pyromania's stun and check the distance before engaging.
Yone.phase: Annie's short range and lack of mobility make engaging harder late in the game, so build on your mid-game lead.
Yone.teamfight: Your team should spread out so multiple allies are not hit by Yone W Spirit Cleave, and Annie should check her position in the formation that Yone R Fate Sealed can reach. If two or three enemies are grouped and your teammates can follow up immediately, prepare Annie P Pyromania's stun and catch them first with Annie R Summon: Tibbers.

Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you will fall asleep shortly afterward and may be hit by a follow-up attack. Before the sleep takes effect, move behind a wall or ally to get out of Zoe Q Paddle Star!'s angle and range. If you see Zoe preparing to cast Zoe Q Paddle Star!, you can interrupt her redirection with a ready Annie P Pyromania stun.
Zoe.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zoe deals mostly magic damage, and Annie has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. However, magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so prioritize dodging the bubble.
Zoe.fight: When your Annie P Pyromania stun is ready, trade as Zoe steps forward to last-hit a minion. After Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to close the gap. Do not step forward without a stun.
Zoe.laning: While your stun is unavailable, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate to build stacks. Annie E Molten Shield can also add a stack without consuming the stun.
Zoe.combo: When targeting Zoe alone, open with a ready Annie P Pyromania stun on Annie Q Disintegrate, then use Annie W Incinerate and a basic attack while she is stunned. In a fight where several enemies are grouped, prepare your stun, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate in that order. Before going in, check that another damaging ability has not consumed your stun.
Zoe.escape: If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, wait so you can land your stun at the starting point she must return to. Use the movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to get into range, but do not force it if your Annie P Pyromania stun is not ready.
Zoe.phase: In the late game, it becomes harder for Annie to get into range, so use your earlier lead to build an advantage in the mid game.
Zoe.teamfight: Prepare your Annie P Pyromania stun and, after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down, go in from a position where your allies can follow up immediately. If two or three enemies are grouped, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate.

Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, it can launch a tornado that knocks you up. When you hear and see its stacks are ready, sidestep out of its line. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the gap, and one knockup can lead into Yasuo R Last Breath, so keep your distance first. Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks projectiles; save key abilities until the wall disappears.
Yasuo.build: Start with Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. The main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath is physical, and Annie has low armor, so build armor first. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.fight: Proc the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with one poke, then trade once it disappears and the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready. Right after Yasuo launches the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, he briefly has no way to knock you up, giving you an opening to go in. Use the shield and movement speed from Annie E Molten Shield to help you approach, but keep your distance if Yasuo has many minions he can use to close the gap with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.laning: When the stun from Annie P Pyromania is unavailable, stay back and last-hit minions with Annie Q Disintegrate while building stacks. Annie E Molten Shield can also build a stack without consuming the stun.
Yasuo.combo: For a single-target opening when Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield has disappeared and Yasuo W Wind Wall is also absent, ready Annie P Pyromania’s stun and start with Annie Q Disintegrate.
Yasuo.escape: Look for an opening right after Yasuo launches the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. If Yasuo R Last Breath is also still on cooldown, it is a chance to go in with crowd control. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so do not assume you are safe just because he used it once.
Yasuo.phase: Annie’s burst is strongest in the mid game, when she has two or three ability power items. Range and mobility make it harder for her to get in late, so play to press the lead you gained earlier.
Yasuo.teamfight: Once the stun from Annie P Pyromania is ready, if two or three enemies group up where your allies can immediately follow up, use Annie R Summon: Tibbers for an area stun, then follow with Annie W Incinerate and Annie Q Disintegrate. Save key abilities while Yasuo W Wind Wall is up, and look for the moment it disappears.
